item.g:title: French Natural Style Bouquet | Azure Garden
item.g:description: Designed in a rustic hand-tied fresh bouquet style, "Azure Garden" features Austin roses in soft pink, creamy white and warm yellow, paired with blue delphinium, gentle pink hellebores and fresh chamomile, accented with herbs like eucalyptus and mint, exuding a delicate, refreshing aura. Ideal for gifting to close friends, loved ones or elders, it conveys tender wishes and pure sentiments.

item.g:title: Purple Haze Peach
item.g:description: This "Purple Haze Peach" bouquet combines peach-colored roses, light purple delphinium, soft pink hellebores, and fresh chamomile, accented with eucalyptus leaves and lace flowers. Its natural forest-inspired design is perfect for gifting to mothers, best friends, or for birthdays and anniversaries, carrying gentle, refined wishes that bring a full sense of comfort and healing.

item.g:title: Mist Blue Bellflower
item.g:description: This French-inspired natural fresh flower bouquet is wrapped in mist blue wrapping paper, combining a variety of fresh blooms including bellflowers, astrantia, and chamomile, paired with greens such as eucalyptus, mint, and fern fronds. It showcases a minimalist natural forest style, ideal for gifting to close friends or elders, conveying gentle and pure sentiments on birthdays or anniversaries, while bringing a soothing, healing ambiance.

item.g:title: Peach Lace
item.g:description: Featuring champagne-hued Juliet Garden Roses and Vintage Pink Roses as the focal blooms, accented with Feverfew and Lace Flower. No lavender or eustoma is included. Wrapped in charcoal gray waterproof cotton paper, crafted in the French style of spiral design with stems exposed. Hong Kong online fresh flower ordering with a French pastoral natural aesthetic.

item.g:title: Nude Pink Dawn
item.g:description: Hong Kong French natural-style fresh flower bouquet, featuring abundant light blue delphinium, feverfew, eucalyptus leaves, and ferns, complemented by peach and white bellflowers with chamomile at the center. Wrapped in Morandi matte grey-blue art paper and tied with a dark grey velvet ribbon. Delivery available across Hong Kong, ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, and home decor floral gifts – order fresh bouquets online from our florist.

item.g:title: French Countryside • Vintage Floral Whispers
item.g:description: The wind drifts from Monet’s garden; the charcoal grey wrapping has been replaced by the rustic earthy hues of sage green and caramel. Coral orange and cream garden roses hold the tenderness of time’s depths, while bellflowers and lace flowers carry the carefree rhythm in the air. Not vying for attention among other blooms, this arrangement tells a tale of vintage and eternal tranquility with its casual yet vibrant spirit.

item.g:title: French Countryside • Dawn’s Tale
item.g:description: As dawn breaks, charcoal-hued mist, softened by sage green and caramel-toned earthy undertones, is gently roused by the first light of morning. Delicate Juliet garden roses and buttercream nerines bloom within, like quiet guardians of the countryside’s hidden depths. Casually scattered feverfew and delicate laceflowers are carefree promises whispered in the morning breeze. This arrangement shuns ostentation, speaking only of serene moments through its natural vitality.

item.g:title: French Countryside • Dawn Tale
item.g:description: The serene carefree of a countryside dawn. Enveloped in charcoal grey tones, with sage green and caramel hues evoking rural earth, soft charcoal grey dawn mist lingers. Gentle Juliet Garden Roses and cream nerine lilies bloom within, like a quiet vigil in the heart of the countryside. Casually scattered feverfew and delicate lace flowers whisper the carefree promise of the morning breeze. This arrangement does not vie for attention, but speaks of a serene moment with its vitality.

item.g:title: French Peach Fresh Flower Bouquet

item.g:title: Deep Red Lavender
